headline: Air Liquide Egypt Starts Pipeline Gas Supply to Saint-Gobain Glass Plant
summary: Air Liquide Egypt commenced industrial gas supply to Saint-Gobain's glass manufacturing complex in Ain Sokhna via an integrated pipeline network under a long-term expansion agreement.
why: Industrial gas pipeline distribution reduces unit production costs and supports heavy manufacturing expansion across Egypt's Suez economic zone.

impacts.name: Air Liquide
impacts.why: Transitioned client Saint-Gobain to long-term pipeline deliveries in Ain Sokhna.
